# runzero_hosted_zones (Data Source)

Fetches a list of RunZero hosted zones.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `hosted_zones` (Attributes List) List of hosted zones. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--hosted_zones))

<a id="nestedatt--hosted_zones"></a>
### Nested Schema for `hosted_zones`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the hosted zone is enabled.
- `explorers_concurrency` (Number) Number of concurrent explorers.
- `explorers_total` (Number) Total number of explorers.
- `id` (String) The UUID of the hosted zone.
- `name` (String) The name of the hosted zone.
- `organization_id` (String) The organization ID.
- `tasks_active` (Number) Number of active tasks.
- `tasks_waiting` (Number) Number of waiting tasks.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp (ISO 8601 date-time).
